title: Toge Toge no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + Doping as the peak (the fruit has no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (a plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, English name Spike-Spike Fruit: sprout spikes from any part of the body
Spike fingers (stabbing through Nami); spikes under the feet used to run like stilts; arms and body turned into spikes to pin Nami against a wall
Toge Toge Doping: spikes inside the arms make them bigger and stronger
Nami defeated her with the Clima-Tact's Thunderbolt Tempo (Alabasta)
User: Zala, Miss Doublefinger, Baroque Works Officer Agent

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird swirly#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite, of a weird swirly fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic. That's just a devil fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,
you got the spike, spike fruit.

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you grow sharp spikes#red out of any part of your body.#gold
lines.say: A paramecia, that lets you grow sharp spikes, out of any part of your body.

lines.text: First, your fingers#pink stretch into long, sharp spikes.#red
lines.say: First, your fingers stretch into long, sharp spikes.

lines.text: Then you grow spikes under your feet#blue and run around on them like stilts.#green
lines.say: Then you grow spikes under your feet, and run around on them like stilts.

lines.text: You can even turn your arms into a wall of spikes#red to pin enemies down.#orange
lines.say: You can even turn your arms into a wall of spikes, to pin enemies down.

lines.text: Your strongest trick is Doping:#gold spikes inside your arms pump them up into giant weapons.#red
lines.say: Your strongest trick is doping. Spikes inside your arms, pump them up into giant weapons.

lines.text: But all those spikes lost to a weather stick.#blue
lines.say: But all those spikes, lost to a weather stick.

lines.text: Nami#orange beat her with a lightning bolt#gold from the Clima-Tact.#blue
lines.say: Nami beat her with a lightning bolt from the clima tact.

lines.text: Zala,#purple known as Miss Doublefinger,#pink used it as a Baroque Works#red agent.
lines.say: Zala, known as miss double finger, used it as a baroque works agent.

lines.text: Users of this fruit give terrible#red hugs.#pink
lines.say: Users of this fruit, give terrible hugs.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
